sn12.24:1.2: I 2 Atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Rājagaham piṇḍāya pāvisi || || 3
sn12.24:1.3: Atha kho āyasmato Sāriputtassa etad ahosi ||
sn12.24:1.4: Atippago kho tāva Rājagahe piṇḍāya carituṃ ||
sn12.24:1.5: yam nunāhaṃ yena aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam ārāmo tenupasaṅkameyyanti || || 4
sn12.24:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto yena aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam ārāmo tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn12.24:2.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtam te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā etad avocuṃ || || 5
sn12.24:3.1: Santāvuso Sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ dukkhaṃ paññāpenti ||
sn12.24:3.2: santi panāvuso Sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā paraṃkatam dukkham paññāpenti ||
sn12.24:3.3: santāvuso Sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkatañca paraṃkatañca dukkham paññāpenti ||
sn12.24:3.4: santi panāvuso Sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃ-kāram aparaṃ-kāram adhicca samuppannam dukkham paññāpenti || || 6
sn12.24:3.5: Idha panāvuso Sāriputta Samaṇo Gotamo kiṃvādī kimakkhāyī ||
sn12.24:3.6: Kathaṃ vyākaramānā ca mayam vuttavādino ceva Samaṇassa Gotamassa assāma na ca Samaṇaṃ Gotamam abhūtena abbhācikkheyyāma || dhammassa cānudhammam vyākareyyāma || na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānam āgaccheyyāti || || 7
sn12.24:4.1: Paṭiccasamuppannam kho āvuso dukkhaṃ vuttaṃ Bhagavatā ||
sn12.24:4.4: iti vadaṃ vuttavādī ceva Bhagavato assa na ca Bhagavantam abhūtena abbhācikkheyya || dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākareyya || na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgaccheyya || 8
sn12.24:5.1: Tatrāvuso ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ dukkham paññāpenti tad api phassapaccayā ||
sn12.24:5.2: ye pi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā paraṃ-kataṃ dukkham paññapenti tad api phassapaccayā ||
sn12.24:5.3: Ye pi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃ-kataṃ ca paraṃkataṃ ca dukkham paññāpenti tad api phassapaccayā ||
sn12.24:5.4: Ye pi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃkāram aparaṃkāram adhiccasamuppannaṃ dukkham paññāpenti tad api phassapaccayā || 9
sn12.24:6.1: Tatrāvuso ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ dukkhaṃ paññāpenti || te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedissantīti || netam ṭhānam vijjati || ||
sn12.24:6.2: Ye pi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā paraṃkataṃ dukkhaṃ paññapenti || te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedissantīti || netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati || ||
sn12.24:6.3: Ye pi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkatañca paraṃkatañca dukkham paññāpenti || te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedissantīti || netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati || ||
sn12.24:6.4: Ye pi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃkaram adhiccasamuppannam dukkhaṃ paññāpenti || te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedissantīti || netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti || || 10
sn12.24:7.1: Assosi kho āyasmā Ānando āyasmato Sāriputtassa tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhim kathāsallāpam || || 11
sn12.24:7.2: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando Rājagahe piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattam piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || ||
sn12.24:7.3: Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando yāvatako āyasmato Sāriputtassa tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhim ahosi kathasallāpo taṃ sabbam Bhagavato ārocesi || || 12
sn12.24:8.1: Sādhu sādhu Ānanda yathā taṃ Sāriputto sammāvyākaramāno vyākareyya ||
sn12.24:8.2: paṭiccasamuppannaṃ kho Ānanda dukkhaṃ vuttam mayā ||
sn12.24:8.5: Iti vadaṃ vuttavādī ceva me assa na ca mam abhūtena vyākareyya na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayham ṭhānam āgaccheyya || || 13
sn12.24:9.1: Tatrānanda ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃ-kataṃ dukkham paññāpenti tad api phassapaccayā || ||
sn12.24:9.4: Ye pi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃkāram aparaṃkāram adhiccasamuppannaṃ dukkham paññāpenti tad api phassapaccayā || || 14
sn12.24:10.1: Tatrānanda ye pi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ dukkham paññāpenti || te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedissantīti netam ṭhānaṃ vijjati || ||
sn12.24:10.4: Ye pi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃkaram aparaṃkāram adhiccasamuppannam dukkham paññāpenti || te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedissantīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati || || 15
sn12.24:11.1: Ekam idāham Ānanda samayam idheva Rājagahe viharāmi Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe || || 16
sn12.24:11.2: Atha khvāham Ānanda pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Rājagahe piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ || || 17
sn12.24:11.4: Atippago kho tāva Rājagahe piṇḍāya carituṃ ||
sn12.24:11.5: yam nunāhaṃ yena aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam ārāmo tenupasaṅkameyyanti || || 18
sn12.24:12.1: Atha khvāham Ānanda yena aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam ārāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃ || upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodiṃ ||
sn12.24:12.2: sammodanīyam kathaṃ sārāṇīyam vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃ || || Ekam antam nisinnaṃ kho maṃ Ānanda te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā etad avocuṃ || || 19
sn12.24:13.1: Santāvuso Gotama eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ dukkham paññāpenti || ||
sn12.24:13.2: Santi panāvuso Gotama eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā paraṃ-kataṃ dukkham paññāpenti || ||
sn12.24:13.3: Santāvuso Gotama eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃ-katañca paraṃ-katañca dukkhaṃ paññāpenti || ||
sn12.24:13.4: Santi panāvuso Gotama eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayaṃ-kāram aparaṃkāram adhiccasamuppannaṃ dukkham paññāpenti || || 20
sn12.24:13.5: Idha no āyasmā Gotamo kiṃvādī kim akkhāyī ||
sn12.24:13.6: kathaṃ vyākaramānā mayaṃ vuttavādino ceva āyasmato Gotamassa assāma na ca āyasmantaṃ Gotamam abhūtena abbhācikkheyyāma || dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākareyyāma na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānam āgaccheyyāti || || 21
sn12.24:14.1: Evaṃ vuttāham Ānanda te aññatitthiye paribbājake etad avocaṃ || ||
sn12.24:14.2: Paṭiccasamuppannaṃ kho āvuso dukkham vuttaṃ mayā ||
sn12.24:14.5: iti vadaṃ vuttavādī ceva me assa na ca mam abhūtena abbhācikkheyya || dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākareyya na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānam āgaccheyyāti || || 22
sn12.24:15.1: Tatrāvuso ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ dukkham paññāpenti || tad api phassapaccayā || ||
sn12.24:15.4: Ye pi te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā asayam-kāram aparaṃ-kāram adhiccasamuppannam dukkham paññāpenti || tad api phassapaccayā || || 23
sn12.24:16.1: Tatrāvuso ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃ katam dukkhaṃ paññapenti || te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedissantīti || neṭaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati || ||
sn12.24:16.4: Ye pi te samaṇabrāmanā kammavādā asayaṃkāram aparaṃkāram adhiccasamuppannam dukkham paññāpenti || te vata aññatra phassā paṭisaṃvedissantīti netaṃ ṭhānam vijjatīti || || 24
sn12.24:17.2: yatra hi nāma ekena padena sabbo attho vutto bhavissati ||
sn12.24:17.3: siyā nu kho bhante esevattho vitthārena vuccamāno gambhīro ceva assa gambhīravabhāso cā ti || || 25
sn12.24:18.3: Jarāmaraṇaṃ āvuso Ānanda kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikam kimpabhavanti || ||
sn12.24:18.5: Jarāmaraṇaṃ kho āvuso jātinidānam jātisamudayaṃ jātijātikaṃ jātipabhavanti ||
sn12.24:19.1: Sa ce mam bhante evaṃ puccheyyuṃ || ||
sn12.24:19.2: Jāti panāvuso Ānanda kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kimpabhavāti ||
sn12.24:19.4: Jāti kho āvuso bhavanidānā bhavasamudayā bhavajātikā bhavapabhavā ti || ||
sn12.24:20.1: Sa ce maṃ bhante evam puccheyyuṃ ||
sn12.24:20.2: Bhavo pānāvuso Ānanda kiṃnidāno kiṃsamudayo kiṃjātiko kimpabhavoti ||
sn12.24:20.4: Bhavo kho āvuso upādānanidāno upādānasamudayo upādānajātiko upādānappabhavo ti || ||
sn12.24:21.1: Sa ce mam bhante evam puccheyyuṃ ||
sn12.24:21.6: Phasso panāvuso Ānanda kiṃnidāno kiṃsamudāyo kiṃjātiko kimpabhavoti ||
sn12.24:21.8: Phasso kho āvuso saḷāyatananidāno saḷāyatanasamudayo saḷāyatanajātiko saḷāyatanapabhavoti ||
sn12.24:21.9: channam tveva āvuso phassāyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā phassanirodho ||
sn12.24:21.16: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotīti || ||
